name: One Leaf Clover
source:
Souka seems to have a good life, and an even better boyfriend. However, Taru's luck is beyond bad, and his happy-go-lucky attitude just doesn't match up! Just what is the cause of his horrible luck? Will his luck cause an end to their special bond- or strengthen it beyond belief?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25920]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
索卡似乎过着美好的生活，还有一个更加优秀的男朋友。然而，塔鲁的运气糟糕透顶，他那种无忧无虑的态度和糟糕运气完全不相称！究竟是什么导致了他的厄运？他的运气会终结两人之间的特殊羁绊，还是让这份羁绊变得牢不可破？

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25920]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
